items.title: Try Sonnet for small and medium jobs
items.detail: Opus took 99% of Claude spend in the last 28 days. Your small and medium tasks cost a median $2.43 on Opus and $1.09 on Sonnet, and passed CI first time 88% and 100% of the time. Switch with /model sonnet for fixes and small features, and keep Opus for big or tricky work.

items.title: Keep sessions to one task each
items.detail: Each reply read 233k tokens on average in the last 7 days (221k the week before). Re-reading that context was 44% of Claude spend. Start a new session for each task, and /clear when you switch to something unrelated, so replies stop carrying old work.

items.title: Start fresh after a break instead of resuming
items.detail: 12 cache rebuilds cost $13 in the last 7 days (10 the week before). Once a session sits idle for an hour its cache expires, and the next reply pays to write the whole conversation again. After a long break, start a new session with a short summary, or run /compact before you step away.

items.title: CI is failing more often on the first push
items.detail: 18 of 22 tasks shipped in the last 14 days passed CI first time, against 98% before (missed: PR #191, PR #174, PR #172). Before pushing, ask Claude to run the same checks CI runs (tests, lint and build) and fix what fails.

items.title: Ask for tests on the tricky part up front
items.detail: 15 later commits changed files from 5 tasks shipped in the last 28 days, most after PR #166 (5). Follow-up fixes usually mean the first pass missed a case, so ask Claude to write a test for the risky part before it builds.

items.title: Claude spend up 57% on the week before
items.detail: $163 in the last 7 days, against $104. That is the third week running it has risen. Busiest day: Sat 7 Nov, at $64.

items.title: Codex use up 4.4x
items.detail: 371 calls in the last 7 days, against 85 the week before.

items.title: Biggest task this week: PR #200
items.detail: "feat(artists): guest spots with Nearby soon on Pipeline and Home (#183)" cost $8.85 over 94 replies, about 3 times your median task ($3.22).
